scenes.text: Hi, I'm Capy. Welcome to CapyWorks, the chillest software factory.
Coding agents are fast. But fast agents ship AI slop: TODOs, dead code, tests that assert nothing, and changes nobody asked for.

So we split the thinking, fast and slow. A coding agent does the slow work, riding on my back. I'm the fast part. I run on Jev, a System One decision model from TypeSafe. I ask typed questions, and get probabilities back in a blink.
Every ticket moves down the line. Intake, triage, build, tests, and then my gate. Every decision is logged, with its probability, its latency, and its cost.
When an agent cuts corners, I notice, even when its tests pass. The change bounces back with the exact checks it failed. The agent tries again, and this time it's clean. That's when I get my yuzu.
Here's a real run from today. Every call I made, how fast I made it, and what it cost.
Agents do the work. Capy makes the calls. This is CapyWorks.
